name: Raw netlink rejects over-capacity pipeline without changing the valid neighbor
verifyCmd: $TC -j p4template get pipeline/names | python3 -c 'import json,sys; assert json.load(sys.stdin)==json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print("UNCHANGED")' /tmp/p4tc-name-$TESTID.json
teardown: sh -c 'set -eu; for id in 22 23; do for n in $(seq 1 200); do out=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ pipeid "$id" 2>&1) && break; case "$out" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; done'
